headline: Filmmakers unveiled a trailer in which the late Val Kilmer plays a priest recreated with AI and his family's consent.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: the trailer was shown on Wednesday, 30 Sep 2026, before the window, and the release date is unknown.
importance_line: A dead actor carrying more than an hour of a feature film through AI, with his estate paid and consenting, sets a working example of the union's consent rules for performers' families, studios and audiences, though whether viewers accept it will only show at release.
summary: The Associated Press reports, as relayed by 6abc, that the first trailer for the indie drama 'As Deep as the Grave', shown at CinemaCon in Las Vegas on Wednesday, 30 Sep 2026, features Val Kilmer, who died in 2025, as a Catholic priest recreated with generative AI from archival material after illness kept him from filming. Director Coerte Voorhees said the team worked with Kilmer's children and followed SAG-AFTRA standards of "consent, compensation and collaboration"; the estate was paid, Kilmer is on screen for more than an hour, and no release date has been set.
notes: Source credited to AP, which 6abc cites for the filmmakers' statements; the url is the 6abc page where the text was read. Event date inferred from 'Wednesday' in an article published 4 Oct 2026.
